evaluation.results_summary: The developer-reported results for Qwen1.5-0.5B show scores of 39.2 on MMLU, 50.5 on C-Eval, 22.0 on GSM8K, 3.1 on MATH, 12.2 on HumanEval, 6.8 on MBPP, 18.3 on BBH, and 46.6 on CMMLU. Additional reported scores include 26.98 on Exams, 44.08 on Understanding, 3.13 on Math, and 9.17 on Translation.

training_context.adaptations: The base model is not recommended for direct text generation; post-training such as SFT, RLHF, or continued pretraining is suggested before use.
